records.text: Owens alleged that, on the day Charlie Kirk died, Justin Streiff called a printer to at least double the order for Stop, in the Name of God, then obtained Erika Kirk’s approval.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep 7FS1tUeSfdE)

appearances.snippet: But just hours after Charlie (Charlie Kirk) died, Justin Streiff allegedly, apparently reached out to the printer and said that, let's order some more books. ... I'm going to ask Erika (Erika Kirk) and I'll call you back, but we're going to need to at least double that order. ... He reached out to Erika (Erika Kirk) and got her permission and then he immediately circled back to the printing agency and said, it's a go. ... Erika (Erika Kirk) says yes.

verification.notes: The transcript attributes the printer call and Erika Kirk approval to an anonymous tip that Owens said her team verified, but it provides no printer name, order record, call record, invoice, or identified witness. Current searches found no independent source confirming the call or doubled order.
